parameters.description: Text to match in the file name, description or content type. The match ignores case.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The property to sort by. The default is the creation time.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: When true, sorts in descending order. The default is false.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of rows to skip. The default is 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: The number of rows to return. The default is 25.

200.description: The body is a table object with the matching rows in data and the total in recordsTotal.

400.description: The search failed. The body is an error message.

401.description: The caller is not signed in.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

post.summary: Upload files to a vault secret
post.description:
Uploads one or more files in a multipart form and stores them encrypted in the vault secret. A file with the same name and content type as a file already in the secret replaces that file. When malware scanning is turned on in the encrypted file settings, each file is scanned before it is stored.

Permission required: Admin role (or the App role).

Caution: Uploading a file with the same name and content type as an existing file in the secret replaces that file's content immediately. Files are stored one at a time, so if a later file in the same request fails (for example the malware scan), earlier files in that request are already stored.

parameters.name: secretVaultId
parameters.description: The ID of the vault secret to store the files in.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description saved with the files. When omitted, new files get an empty description and replaced files keep their existing description.

requestBody.description:
A multipart/form-data body with one file part per file.

- `(file part)` (file, required): A file to store. The part's file name and content type are saved with it. Each file must be within the maximum size set in the encrypted file settings (in MB).

Example request:

```
curl -X POST "https://HOST:6500/api/v1/EncryptedFile/Upload/SECRET_VAULT_ID?description=Example%20description" -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" -F "example.pem=@example.pem;type=application/x-pem-file"
```

200.description: The files were stored. The body is a summary with secretVaultId, description, fileCount, totalSize, uploadTime and details, a list with the id, name, contentType, size, checksum and timestamps of each file.

204.description: The request had no content type, so nothing was stored.

400.description: The vault secret was not found, a file is too large or invalid, the malware scan failed, or the upload failed. The body is an error message.

401.description: The caller is not signed in.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only access.

415.description: The content type is not multipart/form-data.

put.description:
Updates the description of an encrypted file and returns the file record without its content. Only the description changes.

Permission required: Admin role (or the App role).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the file.

requestBody.description:
The file object. Only the description is used.

- `description` (string): The new description of the file. If omitted, the description is cleared.

200.description: The file was updated. The body is the file record without its content.

400.description: The update failed. The body is an error message.

401.description: The caller is not signed in.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only access.

404.description: No file has this ID. The body is a message.

get.summary: List recent events
get.description:
Returns events from the event log, newest first. Use skip and take to page through them.

Permission required: Admin, App, or Auditing and Reporting role.

Values for `eventType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = Status, 2 = ServiceStart, 3 = PasswordRotation, 4 = HostScan, 5 = ADSync, 6 = ActivitySession, 7 = Manage, 8 = Unmanage, 9 = Verify, 10 = RotateServices, 11 = CommandRestrictionAction.

Values for `status`: 0 = Information, 1 = Warning, 2 = Error.

Values for `serviceType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = WebUi, 2 = ActionService, 3 = ProxyService, 4 = SchedulerService, 5 = EmailService, 6 = ADSyncService, 7 = RagGateway, 8 = RagPortal.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of events to skip. The default is 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: The number of events to return. The default is 10.

200.description: The body is an array of events.

400.description: The request failed. The body is an error message.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

get.summary: Search events
get.description:
Returns a page of events matching the filters. Filter by text, event type, service, status, resource, account, account group, domain or activity session. Use it to build audit views.

Permission required: Admin, App, or Auditing and Reporting role.

Values for `eventType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = Status, 2 = ServiceStart, 3 = PasswordRotation, 4 = HostScan, 5 = ADSync, 6 = ActivitySession, 7 = Manage, 8 = Unmanage, 9 = Verify, 10 = RotateServices, 11 = CommandRestrictionAction.

Values for `status`: 0 = Information, 1 = Warning, 2 = Error.

Values for `serviceType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = WebUi, 2 = ActionService, 3 = ProxyService, 4 = SchedulerService, 5 = EmailService, 6 = ADSyncService, 7 = RagGateway, 8 = RagPortal.

parameters.name: filterText
parameters.description: Text to search for in the event message. The match ignores case.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The property to sort by. When omitted, events are sorted newest first.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: When true, sorts in descending order. The default is false.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of rows to skip. The default is 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: The number of rows to return. The default is 100.

parameters.name: filterEventType
parameters.description: Only events of this type. See the `Values for` paragraphs in the operation description.

parameters.name: filterServiceType
parameters.description: Only events logged by this service. See the `Values for` paragraphs in the operation description.

parameters.name: filterStatus
parameters.description: Only events with this status. See the `Values for` paragraphs in the operation description.

parameters.name: domainConfigId
parameters.description: Only events for the resource that represents this domain. When set, it replaces managedResourceId. If no domain resource matches this ID, the call fails with a server error.

parameters.name: managedResourceId
parameters.description: Only events for this resource.

parameters.name: managedAccountId
parameters.description: Only events for this managed account.

parameters.name: managedAccountGroupId
parameters.description: Only events for the accounts in this group. An ID that matches no group applies no filter.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Only events for this activity session.

200.description: The body is a table object with the matching events in data and the total in recordsTotal.

400.description: A parameter value could not be read, for example an ID that is not a GUID or a filter value that is not a valid number or name.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

500.description: The domainConfigId matches no domain resource, or the search failed unexpectedly.

get.summary: Get an event
get.description:
Returns the event with the given ID.

Permission required: Admin, App, or Auditing and Reporting role.

Values for `eventType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = Status, 2 = ServiceStart, 3 = PasswordRotation, 4 = HostScan, 5 = ADSync, 6 = ActivitySession, 7 = Manage, 8 = Unmanage, 9 = Verify, 10 = RotateServices, 11 = CommandRestrictionAction.

Values for `status`: 0 = Information, 1 = Warning, 2 = Error.

Values for `serviceType`: 0 = Unspecified, 1 = WebUi, 2 = ActionService, 3 = ProxyService, 4 = SchedulerService, 5 = EmailService, 6 = ADSyncService, 7 = RagGateway, 8 = RagPortal.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the event.

200.description: The body is the event.

400.description: The request failed. The body is an error message.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

404.description: No event has this ID.

post.description:
Creates a command plan, with its command sets, commands and result actions, on a platform. The platform must be a custom platform created from a base platform.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The new plan and the commands in it are saved immediately, and the commands can later run against the systems that use the platform.

requestBody.description:
The command plan to create, including its nested command sets, commands and result actions.

- `id` (string (GUID)): ID of the command plan. Optional. If you leave it out, the system assigns one.
- `platformId` (string (GUID), required): ID of the platform the plan belongs to. Must be a custom platform created from a base platform. Otherwise nothing is created and the response is 204.
- `name` (string): Name of the command plan. The server does not check it, but the name is how other routes find the plan by name.
- `description` (string): Description of the command plan.
- `connectionType` (string): Connection type the plan uses.
- `permanent` (boolean): Marks the plan as permanent.
- `commandSets` (array): Ordered command sets in the plan. Each command set has an id, name, description, executionOrder and a commands array. Each command has an id, commandToSend, commandScript, executionOrder and a resultActions array. Each result action has an id, expectedResult, executionOrder and flags that control how the output is matched and what happens next. Do not send nodeId, createdDateTimeUtc or modifiedDateTimeUtc; the system sets them.

200.description: The plan was created. The response body is the created command plan.

204.description: The platform is missing or is not a custom platform created from a base platform. Nothing is created and the response has no body.

400.description: The body is missing, a plan with the same ID already exists, a command script was rejected by the malware scan, or the plan could not be created. The response text explains why.

get.summary: Get a command plan by name and platform
get.description:
Returns the command plan with the given name on the given platform, including its command sets, commands and result actions. The name match ignores letter case.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The response contains the full text of every command and script in the plan, which can include sensitive content.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the command plan.

parameters.name: platformId
parameters.description: ID of the platform the plan belongs to.

200.description: The command plan, with its command sets, commands and result actions in execution order.

400.description: The request failed. The response text explains why.

404.description: No plan with that name exists on that platform.

get.summary: List all command plans for a platform
get.description:
Returns every command plan on the platform, each with its command sets, commands and result actions. Use NamesAndIds instead when you only need plan names and IDs.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The response contains the full text of every command and script in every plan on the platform, which can include sensitive content.

parameters.name: platformId
parameters.description: ID of the platform whose command plans to return.

200.description: A list of command plans. The list is empty when the platform has none.

400.description: The request failed. The response text explains why.

get.summary: List command plan names and IDs for a platform
get.description:
Returns the name and ID of each command plan on the platform. Use it to populate a picker or to find a plan ID before calling Get.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

parameters.name: platformId
parameters.description: ID of the platform whose command plans to list.

200.description: A list of objects, each with an id and a name. The list is empty when the platform has none.

400.description: The request failed. The response text explains why.

delete.summary: Delete a command plan and its contents
delete.description:
Deletes the command plan together with its command sets, commands and result actions. Use it to remove a plan you no longer need.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The deletion takes effect immediately, cannot be undone, and also removes every command set, command and result action in the plan.

parameters.name: commandPlanId
parameters.description: ID of the command plan to delete.

200.description: The command plan and its contents were deleted. The response has no body.

400.description: The plan could not be deleted. The response text explains why.

404.description: No command plan exists with that ID.

get.summary: Get a command plan by ID
get.description:
Returns the command plan with its command sets, commands and result actions in execution order.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

parameters.name: commandPlanId
parameters.description: ID of the command plan.

200.description: The command plan.

400.description: The request failed. The response text explains why.

404.description: No command plan exists with that ID.

put.description:
Updates the command plan and its command sets, commands and result actions to match the body. The plan's platform must be a custom platform created from a base platform.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: Command sets, commands and result actions that are in the saved plan but missing from the body are deleted.

parameters.name: commandPlanId
parameters.description: ID of the command plan to update.

requestBody.description:
The full command plan as it should be after the update. Start from the plan returned by a get and change it, because every value in the body replaces the saved value.

- `id` (string (GUID), required): ID of the command plan. Set it to the same value as commandPlanId in the path. The update is applied to the plan with this ID; if it is missing or unknown, the call returns 400.
- `platformId` (string (GUID), required): ID of the platform the plan belongs to. The saved plan must belong to a custom platform created from a base platform.
- `name` (string): Name of the command plan. The update replaces the saved name with this value, so send the current name unless you are renaming the plan.
- `description` (string): Description of the command plan.
- `connectionType` (string): Connection type the plan uses.
- `permanent` (boolean): Marks the plan as permanent.
- `commandSets` (array): Ordered command sets in the plan. Each command set has an id, name, description, executionOrder and a commands array. Each command has an id, commandToSend, commandScript, executionOrder and a resultActions array. Each result action has an id, expectedResult, executionOrder and flags that control how the output is matched and what happens next. Include every command set, command and result action you want to keep, with their IDs. Items without a matching ID are added.

200.description: The plan was updated. The response body is the updated command plan.

400.description: The body is missing, the body ID does not match a saved plan, the platform is not a custom platform, or the update failed. The response text explains why.

404.description: No command plan exists with that ID.

get.summary: Search Active Directory groups with paging
get.description:
Returns a page of Active Directory groups known to Privilege Secure, with the total group count. Use it to browse or search groups.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of groups to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of groups to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: sortColumn
parameters.description: Name of the group property to sort by, for example name. If it is omitted or not a property, the results are unsorted.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction, asc or desc (lowercase). Defaults to desc. Applies only when sortColumn names a group property; any other value leaves the results unsorted.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text. Matches groups whose name, account name or email address contains it, ignoring letter case.

parameters.name: FilterManaged
parameters.description: Set to true to return only groups that are not deleted and are not yet used as managed account groups. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: managed
parameters.description: Accepted but has no effect.

200.description: An object with a data array of groups and a recordsTotal count. recordsTotal is the total number of groups, not the number that match the search text or the FilterManaged filter.

get.summary: List local groups an account belongs to
get.description:
Returns the groups that the specified host account belongs to, on hosts that are managed resources. Use it to show an account's local group memberships.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the host account (local user) whose groups to return.

200.description: A list of groups, each with id, name, hostId, hostName, managedResourceId, managedResourceName and managedResourceDisplayName. A group on a host with several managed resources appears once per managed resource. The list is empty when the account has no matching groups.

get.summary: Get an Active Directory group by ID
get.description:
Returns the Active Directory group with the specified ID.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the Active Directory group.

200.description: The group.

204.description: No group matches the ID, so the response has no body.

get.summary: List groups and roles you can select across platforms
get.description:
Returns a combined, paged list of Active Directory groups, Entra ID groups and directory roles, and SQL Server and Oracle database roles. Use it to choose a group or role for an access policy or similar setting. Entra ID directory roles appear only for tenants that have a service account configured, and an Entra tenant whose roles cannot be read is skipped without an error. Deleted Active Directory groups and groups in domains linked to an Entra ID tenant are left out.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: platformType
parameters.description: Limits results to one platform: AD, Entra, SQL or Oracle (not case-sensitive). Omit it to include all. Any other value returns an empty page.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100; values above 1000 are reduced to 1000.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text. Matches names (and account names for Active Directory groups, descriptions for Entra roles), ignoring letter case.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort column: name, type, platformName or context. Without it, results sort by type and then name.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: Set to true to sort in descending order. Defaults to false.

200.description: An object with a data array of candidates and a recordsTotal count of all matches before paging. Each item has id, name, type, platformId, platformName, context and additionalInfo, plus hostId, hostDatabaseId, domainId or tenantId where they apply.

500.description: The list could not be built. The response includes an error and message.

get.summary: Get a group or role by ID
get.description:
Returns one group or role from any supported platform. The ID can belong to a SQL Server or Oracle database role, an Entra ID group, or an on-premises Active Directory group. Entra ID directory roles listed by the candidates route cannot be fetched by ID.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the group or role, as returned by the candidates list. IDs of Entra ID directory roles are not accepted and return 404.

200.description: The group or role. Each item has id, name, type, platformId, platformName, context and additionalInfo, plus hostId, hostDatabaseId, domainId or tenantId where they apply.

404.description: No group or role has that ID. The response includes an error and the ID.

500.description: The lookup failed. The response includes an error and message.

post.description:
Creates a host record. A host record must be paired with a managed resource before Privilege Secure can use it; managed resources are normally created by a host scan or the managed resource endpoints.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The host record is created immediately; a host with no managed resource is not usable until one is added.

requestBody.description:
The host to create. Send only the host's own fields and leave related lists such as users and groups out of the body. Other host properties that a get returns, such as samaccountname, isGlobalCatalog and objectSid, are also accepted in the body.

- `id` (string (GUID)): ID of the host. Optional. If you leave it out, the system assigns one.
- `name` (string): Name of the host.
- `dnsHostName` (string): DNS host name.
- `netBiosName` (string): NetBIOS name.
- `distinguishedName` (string): Active Directory distinguished name.
- `ipAddress` (string): IP address of the host.
- `os` (string): Operating system name.
- `version` (string): Operating system version.
- `hasSSH` (boolean): True if the host supports SSH.
- `credentialId` (string (GUID)): ID of the service account credential for the host.
- `activeDirectoryDomainId` (string (GUID)): ID of the domain the host belongs to.
- `activeDirectoryObjectId` (string (GUID)): ID from Active Directory sync, usually the same as the host ID.
- `isVirtual` (boolean): True for virtual hosts such as Entra ID tenants.
- `platformId` (string (GUID)): ID of the platform assigned to the host.

200.description: The host was created. The response body is the host record.

400.description: The host could not be created. The response text explains why.

get.summary: Get a host by ID
get.description:
Returns the host record with its name, addresses, operating system and IDs. Related lists such as users, groups, features, services and scheduled tasks are always returned empty; use the host list routes to read them.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The response includes network details for the host, such as its IP address, and the ID of the service account credential assigned to it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host.

parameters.name: includeReferencedLists
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the host's domain record and to skip hosts marked as deleted. Defaults to false.

200.description: The host record.

400.description: The host could not be retrieved.

404.description: No host exists with that ID.

put.description:
Updates the host record with the values in the body. The ID in the body must match the ID in the URL.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The change takes effect immediately and replaces every saved value, so fields you leave out are cleared; start from the record returned by a get.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host to update.

requestBody.description:
The full host record with its updated values and the same ID as in the URL. Related lists in the body are ignored. Other host properties that a get returns, such as samaccountname, isGlobalCatalog and objectSid, are also accepted in the body.

- `id` (string (GUID), required): ID of the host. Must equal the ID in the URL; otherwise the call returns 400.
- `name` (string): Name of the host.
- `dnsHostName` (string): DNS host name.
- `netBiosName` (string): NetBIOS name.
- `distinguishedName` (string): Active Directory distinguished name.
- `ipAddress` (string): IP address of the host.
- `os` (string): Operating system name.
- `version` (string): Operating system version.
- `hasSSH` (boolean): True if the host supports SSH.
- `credentialId` (string (GUID)): ID of the service account credential for the host.
- `activeDirectoryDomainId` (string (GUID)): ID of the domain the host belongs to.
- `activeDirectoryObjectId` (string (GUID)): ID from Active Directory sync, usually the same as the host ID.
- `isVirtual` (boolean): True for virtual hosts such as Entra ID tenants.
- `platformId` (string (GUID)): ID of the platform assigned to the host.

200.description: The host was updated. The response body is the updated host record.

400.description: The IDs do not match, no host exists with that ID, or the host could not be updated. The response text explains why.

get.summary: Get the domain a host belongs to
get.description:
Returns the Active Directory domain record for the host.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Caution: The response can include domain connection details, such as the domain controller name and the ID of the service account used to connect.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host.

200.description: The domain record, including its domain configuration.

204.description: The host refers to a domain record that no longer exists, so the response has no body.

400.description: The domain could not be retrieved. Some errors return 500 instead.

404.description: No host exists with that ID or the host is marked as deleted, or the host is not a member of a domain.

get.summary: List discovered scheduled tasks on a host
get.description:
Returns a page of the scheduled tasks discovered on the host, with the total count. Use it to see what runs on a host and under which account.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Name of the property to sort by, for example name. If it is omitted or does not name a property, the results are not sorted in a defined order.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: Set to true to sort in descending order. Defaults to false. Applies only when orderBy names a property.

parameters.name: filterText
parameters.description: Search text. Matches name, user name or description, ignoring letter case.

200.description: An object with a data array of scheduled tasks and a recordsTotal count of all matches.

get.summary: List discovered services on a host
get.description:
Returns a page of the services discovered on the host, with the total count. Use it to see what runs on a host and under which account.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role. The session must have completed multifactor authentication.

Values for `startType`: 0 = Boot, 1 = System, 2 = Automatic, 3 = Manual, 4 = Disabled.

Values for `serviceType (flags, values add together)`: 1 = KernelDriver, 2 = FileSystemDriver, 4 = Adapter, 8 = RecognizerDriver, 16 = Win32OwnProcess, 32 = Win32ShareProcess, 256 = InteractiveProcess.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Name of the property to sort by, for example name. If it is omitted or does not name a property, services sort by display name ascending.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: Set to true to sort in descending order. Defaults to false. Applies only when orderBy names a property.

parameters.name: filterText
parameters.description: Search text. Matches name, display name, user name or description, ignoring letter case.

200.description: An object with a data array of services and a recordsTotal count of all matches. startType and serviceType are numbers; see the value lists.

get.summary: Search discovered database servers on hosts
get.description:
Returns a page of database servers discovered on hosts, with the total count. Use it to find database instances by host, type or name.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

Values for `filterType and type`: -1 = Unknown, 0 = PostgreSQL, 1 = SqlServer, 2 = Sqlite, 3 = Oracle, 4 = MySql.

parameters.name: filterText
parameters.description: Search text. Matches database name, full name or cluster name, ignoring letter case.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Name of the property to sort by, for example name. Defaults to fullName.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: Set to true to sort in descending order. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: hostId
parameters.description: Return only databases on this host.

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: Return only databases of this type, as a number. Omit it or use -1 for all types. See the value list.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

200.description: An object with a data array of database servers and a recordsTotal count.

400.description: The search failed. The response text explains why.

get.summary: Search discovered features on hosts
get.description:
Returns a page of the features discovered on hosts, with the total count. Use it to find features by host or by name, description or version.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: filterText
parameters.description: Search text. Matches feature name, description or version, ignoring letter case.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Name of the property to sort by. Defaults to name.

parameters.name: orderDescending
parameters.description: Set to true to sort in descending order. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: hostId
parameters.description: Return only features on this host.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

200.description: An object with a data array of features and a recordsTotal count.

get.summary: Get a discovered host feature by ID
get.description:
Returns one feature discovered on a host, with its name, version, description and host ID, and the record of the host it was found on.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the host feature.

200.description: The host feature, including its host record.

400.description: The feature could not be retrieved. The response text explains why.

404.description: No host feature exists with that ID.

get.summary: List local groups on a host
get.description:
Returns a page of the local groups discovered on the host, with the total count. Use it to see which groups exist on a managed host.

Permission required: Administrator role or application role.

Caution: The response includes details of each group's member accounts, which can include sensitive values.

parameters.name: hostId
parameters.description: ID of the host.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of groups to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of groups to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: orderBy

post.summary: Create host scan jobs for a list of hosts
post.description:
Creates a scan job for the hosts in the request and returns its status. Use it to onboard new hosts or to scan hosts by name with a service account.

Permission required: Admin or App role.

Values for `sshTrustActionType`: 0 = AlwaysTrustIgnoreThumbprint, 1 = WarnOnThumbprintMismatch, 2 = ErrorOnThumbprintMismatch.

Values for `certificateType`: 0 = WinRM, 1 = RDP, 2 = SSH.

requestBody.description:
A list with one entry for each host to scan. The list must contain at least one entry.

- `dnsHostName` (string, required): DNS name of the host to scan. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.
- `credentialId` (string (GUID)): ID of the service account used to connect to the host. Provide either credentialId or credentialName. One of them is required.
- `credentialName` (string): Name of the service account used to connect to the host. If given, it is looked up and replaces credentialId. An unknown name returns an error.
- `hostId` (string (GUID)): ID of a host that is already known to the system. Use it to scan that exact host instead of matching by name or address.
- `ipAddress` (string): IP address to use if the DNS name does not resolve.
- `os` (string): Operating system value to record if the scan cannot detect one.
- `platformName` (string): Name of the platform for the host.
- `acceptThumbprintOnFirstDiscovery` (boolean): When true, the scan can complete and the thumbprint it finds is stored as trusted.
- `sshTrustActionType` (integer): What to do when the connection thumbprint does not match the trusted one. 0 AlwaysTrustIgnoreThumbprint, 1 WarnOnThumbprintMismatch, 2 ErrorOnThumbprintMismatch.
- `certificateType` (integer): Type of connection the trusted thumbprint applies to. 0 WinRM, 1 RDP, 2 SSH.
- `trustedThumbprint` (string): Thumbprint to trust for the connection.
- `sshPort` (integer): SSH port to use when connecting to the host.
- `source` (string): Optional source value for the request.
- `platformDetectionOnly` (boolean): When true, the scan only detects the host platform and operating system and skips the full enumeration of users, groups, features, services, tasks and databases.

201.description: The body is the scan job status: the job ID, an overall status and description, and a status entry for each host. The Location header points to the new job.

400.description: The request was not valid, for example the list is empty, a host name is missing, no service account was given, or the service account does not exist.

requestBody.description:
The IP address rule to create.

- `address` (string, required): The IP address, address range or CIDR block, matching the rule type. Send a value that matches the rule type.

- `ipAddressRuleType` (integer): How the address value is interpreted. 0 Standard, 1 Range, 2 CIDR. Defaults to 0 Standard if omitted.
- `managedAccountId` (string (GUID)): ID of the managed account the rule belongs to. Provide either managedAccountId or activityConfigurationId. One of them is required.
- `activityConfigurationId` (string (GUID)): ID of the activity configuration the rule belongs to.

Caution: The update takes effect immediately, and an update that keeps the same address, allow setting and type as the stored rule is rejected as a duplicate.

- `ipAddressRuleType` (integer): How the address value is interpreted. 0 Standard, 1 Range, 2 CIDR. Defaults to 0 Standard if omitted.
- `managedAccountId` (string (GUID)): ID of the managed account the rule belongs to. Provide either managedAccountId or activityConfigurationId. One of them is required.
- `activityConfigurationId` (string (GUID)): ID of the activity configuration the rule belongs to.

400.description: The body is missing, no owner was given, or the same rule already exists. The body explains why.

post.description:

Caution: The user is added immediately and the call is recorded in the audit log.

requestBody.description:
The NPS user to add. Supply userId or sid, and a name unless you supply a sid.

- `userId` (string (GUID)): The ID of the host user to add. Required unless sid is supplied.
- `sid` (string): The Windows security identifier of the user to add. When set, the call looks up the user by SID and replaces any userId you send. The call fails with 400 if no user has that SID.
- `name` (string): The name to show for the NPS user. Required unless you supply a sid and the matching user has a display name.
- `type` (integer): The kind of account. See the account type values. The default is 0 (HostUser).
- `isReviewer` (boolean): Whether the user is a reviewer.

200.description: Returns the new NPS user.

400.description: The user could not be added. The body is a text message that includes the reason.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

post.description:

Permission required: Admin or App role.

Values for `entityType`: 0 = HostUser, 1 = DomainGroup, 2 = ApplicationUser, 3 = DomainGroupMember.

requestBody.description:
An array of the users and groups to add.

- `id` (string (GUID), required): The ID of the host user or domain group to add. Take it from the Host User Search call.
- `entityType` (integer, required): The kind of entry. Use 0 for a domain user and 1 for a domain group. Entries with other values are skipped and not counted.

200.description: Returns the number of entries that passed and failed, with a report array of messages. Entries that are already NPS users or groups, users that are not domain users, and users that already have a credential with the same domain and user name count as failed.

400.description: The license has expired or the credit limit is reached, or the add failed. The body is a text message.

Use it when you have the ID of the sign-in account rather than the NPS user ID. The policies, resources and activeSessions arrays in the response are always empty and scheduledSessionCount is 0; use the Policies call for the user's policies.

Permission required: Admin or App role.

Values for `sshTrustActionType`: 0 = AlwaysTrustIgnoreThumbprint, 1 = WarnOnThumbprintMismatch, 2 = ErrorOnThumbprintMismatch.

Values for `certificateType`: 0 = WinRM, 1 = RDP, 2 = SSH.

Caution: The change applies immediately. Fields you leave out are saved as their defaults, so send the full resource. A new platform is also applied to the resource's scheduled jobs and credentials.

parameters.name: managedResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource to update. It must match the id in the body.

requestBody.description:
The full resource, as returned by the get-resource call, with your changes.

- `id` (string (GUID), required): ID of the resource. It must match the ID in the path.
- `name` (string): Name of the resource.
- `type` (integer): The kind of resource. Send the value from the get-resource call. A resource saved without it becomes a host (0). See the type values below.
- `displayName` (string): Name shown in the console.
- `platformId` (string (GUID)): ID of the platform of the resource.
- `serviceAccountId` (string (GUID)): ID of the service account used to manage the resource.
- `manageAccount` (integer): Whether the built-in administrator account is managed. See the manageAccount values below.
- `hostId` (string (GUID)): ID of the host the resource is built on.
- `domainConfigId` (string (GUID)): ID of the Active Directory domain configuration, for a domain resource. Required when type is 1 (Domain). It is cleared for other types.
- `portSsh` (integer): SSH port.
- `portRdp` (integer): RDP port.
- `portWinRm` (integer): WinRM HTTP port.
- `portWinRmHttps` (integer): WinRM HTTPS port.
- `disableWinRm` (boolean): Set to true to turn off WinRM for the resource.
- `acceptThumbprintOnFirstDiscovery` (boolean): Whether to trust the first certificate thumbprint the resource presents.
- `trustedThumbprint` (string): The certificate thumbprint that is trusted.
- `sshTrustActionType` (integer): What happens when a discovered thumbprint differs from the trusted one. See the sshTrustActionType values below.
- `certificateType` (integer): The kind of certificate the thumbprint belongs to. See the certificateType values below.

200.description: Returns the updated resource.

400.description: The id in the body does not match the ID in the path.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

500.description: The resource could not be updated, for example because a domain resource has no domainConfigId.

post.description:
Creates a resource group and returns it. Use it to group resources so access policies and protection settings can target them together.

Permission required: Requires the Admin role, or an application account with the App role.

Values for `type`: 0 = Local.

Values for `manageAccounts`: 0 = PerResource, 1 = Unmanaged, 2 = Managed.

requestBody.description:
The resource group to create. When OU mapping is enabled the server finds the domain from the OU distinguished name.

- `id` (string (GUID)): The ID of the resource group. Send a new GUID, as the console does. If you leave it out, the server generates one.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the resource group. Maximum 256 characters. Names are not checked for uniqueness.
- `type` (integer): The type of resource group. 0 = Local.
- `platformId` (string (GUID)): The platform the group is tied to, when it is a built-in platform group. Can be null.
- `manageAccounts` (integer): How the built-in accounts of the group's resources are managed. 0 = PerResource, 1 = Unmanaged, 2 = Managed.
- `notificationEmailList` (string): Comma-separated email addresses that receive notifications for the group. Can be null.
- `ouMappingEnabled` (boolean): Whether the group is mapped to an Active Directory organizational unit (OU). When false, the OU settings are cleared.
- `ouFqdn` (string): The distinguished name of the mapped OU or container. Required when ouMappingEnabled is true. Must start with OU= or CN= and include DC= parts, for example OU=Computers,DC=example,DC=com.
- `ouAutoOnboard` (boolean): Whether resources found in the mapped OU are onboarded automatically.
- `ouIncludeChildren` (boolean): Whether child OUs of the mapped OU are included.
- `ouDomainConfigId` (string (GUID)): The domain that contains the mapped OU. Set by the server from ouFqdn when OU mapping is enabled; cleared when it is disabled.
- `defaultPlatformId` (string (GUID)): The platform given to resources that OU mapping onboards automatically. Can be null; when null the platform is detected as usual.
- `defaultServiceAccountId` (string (GUID)): The service account given to resources that OU mapping onboards automatically. Can be null; when null no service account is assigned.

200.description: The created resource group.

400.description: The OU settings are not valid, for example OU mapping is enabled without an OU distinguished name, the name cannot be parsed, or the domain is not found. The body is the error text.

401.description: The request is not signed in.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

500.description: The group could not be saved, for example the name is missing or longer than 256 characters.

The full resource group. The id must match the route.

- `id` (string (GUID), required): The ID of the resource group. Must match the ID in the route.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the resource group. Maximum 256 characters.
- `type` (integer): The type of resource group. 0 = Local.
- `platformId` (string (GUID)): The platform the group is tied to, when it is a built-in platform group. Can be null.
- `manageAccounts` (integer): How the built-in accounts of the group's resources are managed. 0 = PerResource, 1 = Unmanaged, 2 = Managed.
- `notificationEmailList` (string): Comma-separated email addresses that receive notifications for the group. Can be null.
- `ouMappingEnabled` (boolean): Whether the group is mapped to an Active Directory organizational unit (OU). When false, the OU settings are cleared.
- `ouFqdn` (string): The distinguished name of the mapped OU or container. Required when ouMappingEnabled is true. Must start with OU= or CN= and include DC= parts, for example OU=Computers,DC=example,DC=com.
- `ouAutoOnboard` (boolean): Whether resources found in the mapped OU are onboarded automatically.
- `ouIncludeChildren` (boolean): Whether child OUs of the mapped OU are included.
- `ouDomainConfigId` (string (GUID)): The domain that contains the mapped OU. Set by the server from ouFqdn when OU mapping is enabled; cleared when it is disabled.
- `defaultPlatformId` (string (GUID)): The platform given to resources that OU mapping onboards automatically. Can be null; when null the platform is detected as usual.
- `defaultServiceAccountId` (string (GUID)): The service account given to resources that OU mapping onboards automatically. Can be null; when null no service account is assigned.

200.description: The updated resource group.

400.description: The ID in the body does not match the route (empty body), or the OU settings are not valid, for example OU mapping is enabled without an OU distinguished name, the name cannot be parsed, or the domain is not found (the body is the error text).

post.summary: Rotate built-in admin accounts in a resource group
post.description:

Send all set to true to rotate every managed resource in the group (for a platform group, every managed resource on that platform), or list resource IDs in ids. Resources whose account cannot be rotated are skipped.

Permission required: Requires the Admin role, or an application account with the App role.

Caution: Rotation changes real account passwords on the selected resources, so confirm the selection before you call it.

parameters.name: managedResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

requestBody.description:
Which resources to rotate.

- `ids` (array of string (GUID)): The IDs of the resources to rotate when all is false. Only managed resources are rotated. The IDs are not checked against the group's members.
- `all` (boolean): When true, rotates all managed resources in the group, or on the platform for a platform group. ids is ignored when all is true.
- `filterText` (string): Accepted but not used by this call.

200.description: The number of rotations scheduled, as a plain integer. Resources that could not be scheduled are skipped and are not listed in this response.

400.description: No rotations were scheduled. The body is a list of messages that say why, for example a resource has no host, its platform has no built-in account, the account was not found by a host scan, or the account has dependencies. The list is empty when the request selects no managed resources.

post.description:
Makes each listed host user or credential a managed account. Each entry needs a userId or a credentialId. Entries the caller is not permitted to manage, accounts that are already managed, and accounts that sign in to Privilege Secure are not managed, and the response gives the number that succeeded and the number that did not.

Permission required: Administrator, application, or a delegated user with the Manage permission on the credentials.

Values for `managedType`: 0 = NotManaged, 1 = Manual, 2 = Automatic.

requestBody.description:
A JSON array with one entry for each account to manage.

- `userId` (string (uuid)): The id of the host user to manage.
- `credentialId` (string (uuid)): The id of the credential to manage.
- `managedType` (integer): How the password is managed: Manual or Automatic. 1 = Manual, 2 = Automatic. Defaults to Automatic when omitted. Quoted numbers are also accepted.

200.description: Returns two counts: item1 is the number managed and item2 is the number not managed, including entries the caller was not permitted to manage.

401.description: The caller is not authorized to manage any of the listed credentials.

403.description: The caller does not have the required role or permission.

get.summary: Get the managed user for a host user
get.description:
Returns the managed user record that belongs to the given host user. Use it to find out whether a host user account is managed and how.

Permission required: Administrator, application, or a delegated user with the Rotate Services permission.

Values for `managedType`: 0 = NotManaged, 1 = Manual, 2 = Automatic.

parameters.name: hostUserId
parameters.description: The id of the host user.

200.description: The managed user for the host user.

400.description: The lookup failed. The body is a text message.

401.description: The caller is not signed in.

403.description: The caller does not have the required role or permission.

404.description: No managed user exists for the host user. The body is a text message.

post.description:
Removes the listed managed users so the accounts are no longer managed, and removes their scheduled jobs. Entries the caller is not permitted to unmanage and entries that no longer exist are skipped. For accounts managed through a resource group, the managed user record is still removed, but the scheduled jobs, the credential and the host user are left as they are. The response gives two counts, but the first count reflects the records the call changed rather than strictly the number of accounts, so check the accounts afterward if you need an exact result.

Permission required: Administrator, or a delegated user with the Unmanage permission on the credentials. The caller must have signed in with multi-factor authentication.

Caution: This call takes effect immediately. For accounts that have no dependencies, it also removes their credentials from credential access policies and renames the stored credential by appending its id.

requestBody.description:
A JSON array of managed user ids.

- `(array item)` (string (uuid), required): The id of a managed user to stop managing.

get.summary: List resource groups in a protection policy
get.description:
Returns the resource groups that are in a protection policy.

Permission required: Administrators and application accounts.

parameters.name: protectionPolicyId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the protection policy.

200.description: An array of resource groups.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator or application account.

put.summary: Add a resource group to a protection policy
put.description:
Adds a resource group to a protection policy and reschedules protection. To see the result, read the policy again afterward.

Permission required: Administrators and application accounts.

Caution: The response is the full policy record and can include details of the resources in the policy, so handle it with care.

parameters.name: protectionPolicyId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the protection policy.

requestBody.description:
The identifier of the resource group to add.

- `(body)` (string (GUID), required): The identifier of the resource group. The body is a single JSON identifier.

202.description: The resource group was added. The body is the full policy record as it was read before the change, so it does not yet list the added group, and it has a different shape from the policy returned by the other policy routes.

400.description: No resource group exists with this identifier.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator or application account.

404.description: No protection policy exists with this identifier.

delete.summary: Remove a resource group from a protection policy
delete.description:
Removes one resource group from a protection policy and reschedules protection for the affected resources. The call does not return a body.

Permission required: Administrators and application accounts.

parameters.name: protectionPolicyId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the protection policy.

parameters.name: managedResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the resource group to remove.

202.description: The removal was accepted. No body is returned.

400.description: No resource group exists with this identifier.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator or application account.

404.description: No protection policy exists with this identifier.

put.summary: Disable, enable, delete or restore a policy
put.description:
Sets whether a protection policy is deleted or disabled and reschedules protection. Send only the options to change. Returns the updated policy.

Permission required: Administrators and application accounts.

Caution: Protection is rescheduled before the new status is saved, so deleting, disabling or enabling a policy through this route does not change scheduled protection during the call. The schedule catches up the next time protection is rescheduled for the affected resources, for example when the policy's resources change.

parameters.name: protectionPolicyId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the protection policy.

parameters.name: isDeleted
parameters.description: Set true to mark the policy deleted, or false to restore it. The policy is kept and can be restored.

parameters.name: isDisabled
parameters.description: Set true to disable the policy, or false to enable it.

200.description: The updated protection policy.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator or application account.

404.description: No protection policy exists with this identifier.

get.summary: List service nodes
get.description:
Returns the service nodes known to the proxy service, as it reports them at the time of the call.

Permission required: Administrators only.

Caution: The response can include node properties and network details, so treat it as sensitive.

200.description: An array of nodes, each with id, nid, subject, hostname, advertise, tags and properties.

400.description: The node list could not be retrieved from the proxy.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

get.summary: List service node names and status
get.description:
Returns each distinct service or service node name with a status number. For a named group of services the status is all offline, all online or mixed; for a service node it is the node's own status. The call first tries to refresh node status from the proxy service; if the refresh fails it still returns the last stored status.

Permission required: Administrators only.

Values for `value`: 0 = Offline, 1 = Online (Running), 2 = Mixed (service groups only).

200.description: An array of objects, each with key (the lower-case name) and value (the status number).

400.description: The nodes could not be listed.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

get.summary: Get statistics for a service node
get.description:
Returns current resource statistics for one service node, as reported live by the proxy service.

Permission required: Administrators only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the service node: the id field (not nid) returned by the list service nodes route. It is passed to the proxy service unchanged and is not the stored service record identifier used by the node properties route.

200.description: An array of objects, each with mem, cpu, feature, pid and ppid.

400.description: The statistics could not be retrieved from the proxy.

401.description: The request is not signed in, or the sign-in has expired.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

get.summary: Search recordings of active sessions
get.description:
Searches the recorded activity of sessions that are still in progress and returns metadata for the sessions with matching records. Use it to find live sessions by what was typed or shown.

Permission required: Admin or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

Values for `key`: 0 = All, 1 = Windows_Audit, 2 = StdIn, 3 = StdOut, -1 = Unknown.

parameters.name: searchFilter
parameters.description: Text to look for in the recorded session activity. Needed to get any results; without it the response is empty.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Type of recorded activity to search, as an integer. Defaults to 0 (All).

200.description: The matching session metadata, with the records that matched.

204.description: No search text was given, no sessions matched, or the search could not be completed.

400.description: The search failed.

get.summary: Search recordings of completed sessions
get.description:
Searches the recorded activity of sessions that have ended and returns metadata for the sessions with matching records. Use it to find past sessions by what was typed or shown.

Permission required: Admin or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

Values for `key`: 0 = All, 1 = Windows_Audit, 2 = StdIn, 3 = StdOut, -1 = Unknown.

parameters.name: searchFilter
parameters.description: Text to look for in the recorded session activity. Needed to get any results; without it the response is empty.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Type of recorded activity to search, as an integer. Defaults to 0 (All).

200.description: The matching session metadata, with the records that matched.

204.description: No search text was given, no sessions matched, or the search could not be completed.

400.description: The search failed.

get.summary: List live sessions
get.description:
Returns the sessions that are in progress. Admins see every live session. Other users see their own sessions, plus, when filter is all, the sessions they hold the Live Session Viewer permission for.

Permission required: Admin role, or a role with an auditor permission. Admins receive every live session; other users, including read-only administrators, receive only their own sessions or the sessions they hold the Live Session Viewer permission for. Multi-factor authentication must be complete.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: "mine" returns only the caller's own sessions; any other value, such as "all", also returns every session the caller can view. Defaults to "mine". Admins always receive all live sessions.

200.description: The list of live sessions.

400.description: The list could not be retrieved.

put.summary: Lock or unlock a live session
put.description:
Locks a live session so the user cannot keep working in it, or removes the locks when locked is false. The lock can cover the activity, the resource, the user, or just this session, and the action is recorded in the audit log.

Permission required: Admin role, or a custom role that includes the Lock Session permission for the session's user and resource. Users whose role has an auditor permission can also lock their own sessions. Read-only administrators need the same permission. Multi-factor authentication must be complete.

Caution: Takes effect immediately and can lock the user or resource out of other sessions, depending on the lock options selected.

parameters.name: proxySessionId
parameters.description: ID of the live session (the proxy session ID).

requestBody.description:
The lock request. Set locked to true to lock, or false (the default) to remove all locks.

- `id` (string (guid)): Optional. The session is identified by the path.
- `activitySessionIds` (array of string (guid)): Optional. The session to lock is identified by the path.
- `lockMessage` (string): Message shown to the user in the locked session. Defaults to a standard message that asks the user to contact an administrator.
- `lockTitle` (string): Title of the lock message. Defaults to "Netwrix Privilege Secure".
- `locked` (boolean): True locks the session; false removes all locks. Defaults to false, so a body without it removes all locks.
- `lockActivity` (boolean): Lock the whole activity this session belongs to. Applies when locked is true.
- `lockResource` (boolean): Lock the user and resource combination. Applies when locked is true.
- `lockUser` (boolean): Lock the user's account and all of the user's active and pending sessions, rather than only this session. Applies when locked is true.

200.description: The lock request that was applied.

400.description: The request body was missing or the lock could not be applied.

403.description: The caller does not have permission to lock this session.

404.description: The session or its activity was not found, or the session is no longer live.

get.summary: Get a live session
get.description:
Returns one session that is in progress. Each call adds a "viewed" entry to the audit log unless refresh is true.

Permission required: Admin role, or a custom role that includes the Live Session Viewer permission for the session's user and resource. Users whose role has an auditor permission can also view their own sessions. Read-only administrators need the same permission. Multi-factor authentication must be complete.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: ID of the live session (the proxy session ID).

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Set to true when reloading a session that is already open, so no new "viewed" audit entry is written. Defaults to false.

200.description: The live session.

400.description: The session could not be retrieved, or its recording is not available.

403.description: The caller does not have permission to view this session.

404.description: The session was not found.

delete.description:
Ends a session that is currently in progress and records the action in the audit log. Use it when an auditor needs to cut off a live session.

Permission required: Admin role, or a custom role that includes the Terminate Session permission for the session's user and resource. Users whose role has an auditor permission can also end their own sessions. Read-only administrators need the same permission. Multi-factor authentication must be complete.

Caution: Ends the session immediately and cannot be undone; the user loses their connection.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: ID of the live session (the proxy session ID) to end.

200.description: The session was ended.

400.description: The session could not be ended, or the recording service rejected the request.

403.description: The caller does not have permission to end this session.

404.description: The session was not found or is no longer live.

get.summary: Get recording metadata for a session
get.description:
Returns the recording metadata for one session. The search text, date range and activity type can be supplied to narrow the result; the recording service applies them. Use it to load the details of a session found by a search.

Permission required: Admin role, or a role that grants access to the session's user and resource: Live Session Viewer or View Recordings for an active session, or View Recordings for an ended session. Users can also view their own sessions. Read-only administrators need the same permissions. Multi-factor authentication must be complete.

Values for `key`: 0 = All, 1 = Windows_Audit, 2 = StdIn, 3 = StdOut, -1 = Unknown.

parameters.name: proxySessionId
parameters.description: ID of the session (the proxy session ID).

parameters.name: searchFilter
parameters.description: Text to look for in the recorded session activity.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the date range to search (UTC).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Type of recorded activity to search, as an integer. Defaults to 0 (All).

200.description: The session metadata.

204.description: No metadata could be retrieved for the session.

400.description: The metadata could not be retrieved.

401.description: The caller does not have permission to view this session.

404.description: The session was not found.

get.summary: Download a report as CSV
get.description:
Runs a saved report and returns its results as a CSV file named Report.csv.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: ID of the report.

200.description: The CSV file (text/csv).

400.description: The file could not be created.

404.description: The report was not found.

500.description: The report file could not be generated.

get.summary: Download a report as PDF
get.description:
Runs a saved report and returns its results as a PDF file named Report.pdf.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: ID of the report.

200.description: The PDF file (application/pdf).

400.description: The file could not be created.

404.description: The report was not found.

503.description: The PDF service is busy. Retry later.

get.summary: Get your subscription to a report
get.description:
Returns the calling user's subscription to a report, including the ID of the delivery schedule and whether the CSV and PDF files are sent. Use it to show or edit the user's current subscription.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: ID of the report.

200.description: The subscription.

204.description: The caller is not subscribed to this report.

400.description: The subscription could not be retrieved.

404.description: The report or the caller's account was not found.

post.description:
Runs a saved report and returns its results as a table. The body sets paging, sorting and text filtering for the returned rows.

Permission required: Any signed-in user, with multi-factor authentication complete.

Caution: The results can include sensitive details about accounts, resources and sessions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the report.

requestBody.description:
Paging, sorting and filter settings for the results. The body is required.

- `skip` (integer): Number of rows to skip. Defaults to 0.
- `take` (integer): Number of rows to return. Defaults to 100.
- `orderBy` (string): Name of the column to sort by.
- `orderDescending` (boolean): Sort in descending order. Defaults to false.
- `filterText` (string): Return only rows that contain this text.
- `filterColumns` (array of string): Accepted but not used. The filter text is matched against all text columns of the report.

200.description: The report results: a data list of rows and a recordsTotal count of rows that matched.

400.description: The body is missing, the report does not exist, or the report could not be run.

get.summary: List reports and report folders
get.description:
Returns the folders and reports available to the calling user, including which reports the user has marked as favorites. Use it to build a report browser.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

200.description: An object with a folders list and a reports list.

400.description: The tree could not be retrieved.

404.description: The user or the tree was not found.

put.description:
Replaces the stored settings of an existing report subscription, such as whether the CSV and PDF files are sent. Send the full subscription as returned by the get subscription route, because omitted fields are reset.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

requestBody.description:
The full subscription. The report and account IDs identify which subscription to change.

- `reportId` (string (guid), required): ID of the report.
- `managedAccountId` (string (guid), required): ID of the subscribed account.
- `scheduledChangePolicyId` (string (guid), required): ID of the schedule that controls when the report is sent. Stored value only: changing it here does not reschedule the existing scheduled job. To change the schedule, subscribe again with the current job ID.
- `subscribedToCsv` (boolean): Send the report as a CSV file. Defaults to true if omitted.
- `subscribedToPdf` (boolean): Send the report as a PDF file. Defaults to true if omitted.
- `actionJobId` (string (guid)): ID of the scheduled job for the subscription. Send the current value; if omitted it is cleared.

200.description: The updated subscription.

400.description: The subscription could not be updated.

404.description: No subscription exists for this report and account.

get.summary: Get a report
get.description:
Returns the saved definition of one report: its name, data source, time range and filter conditions.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

Values for `durationType`: 0 = LastHour, 1 = Last4Hours, 2 = Last8Hours, 3 = Last24Hours, 4 = Last5Days, 5 = Last7Days, 6 = Last14Days, 7 = Last30Days, 8 = Custom.

Values for `reportAttributes[].operator`: 0 = Equals, 1 = NotEquals, 2 = Contains, 3 = NotContains, 4 = StartsWith, 5 = EndsWith, 6 = LessThan, 7 = GreaterThan.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the report.

200.description: The report definition.

400.description: The report could not be retrieved.

404.description: The report was not found.

get.summary: List report sources
get.description:
Returns the data sources that reports can be built on, such as session activity, along with the columns each one provides. Use a source's ID when saving a report.

Permission required: Admin, App or Auditing and Reporting role, with multi-factor authentication complete.

200.description: The list of report sources.

400.description: The sources could not be retrieved.

404.description: No report sources exist.

get.summary: List role permissions
get.description:
Returns every permission that can be assigned to a role, with its name, ID and the group it belongs to. Use it to look up permission IDs.

Permission required: Admin role.

200.description: The list of permissions.

400.description: The permissions could not be retrieved.

post.description:
Creates a custom role with the name, description and target that you send. The role starts with no permissions, scope or members; add them with the other role routes. Use it to delegate part of administration to people who are not administrators.

Permission required: Administrator role.

Values for `roleTarget`: 0 = AccessPolicies, 1 = Credentials, 2 = Auditors.

requestBody.description:
The role.

- `name` (string, required): The role name. It must be unique among roles. The comparison ignores case.
- `description` (string): A description of the role.
- `roleTarget` (integer): What the role delegates: access policies, credentials, or auditing. Sent as a number; see the `Values for roleTarget` paragraph in the operation description. When omitted it is 0 (AccessPolicies).
- `allActivities` (boolean): When true, the role covers all activities.
- `allCredentials` (boolean): When true, the role covers all credentials.
- `allPolicies` (boolean): When true, the role covers all access policies.
- `allResources` (boolean): When true, the role covers all resources.
- `allUsers` (boolean): When true, the role covers all users.
- `builtInRole` (boolean): Marks a built-in role. Send false for a custom role.
- `isDeleted` (boolean): Send false.

200.description: Returns the new role, including its ID.

400.description: A role with that name already exists, or the role could not be created.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only administrator access.

post.description:
Gives a user one or more roles in a single call. It handles the built-in Administrator and Reviewer roles and custom roles together. Custom roles the user already holds are skipped and not counted.

Permission required: Administrator role.

Caution: Adding the Administrator role gives the user or group full administrative access to the console.

parameters.name: managedAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the user (managed account) on the Users & Groups page.

requestBody.description:
A JSON array of the roles to add. Send each role with its id and name.

- `id` (string (GUID)): The ID of the role. Required for a custom role, which is matched by ID. Not used for the built-in Administrator and Reviewer roles.
- `name` (string): The name of the role. Required for the built-in roles, which are matched by this exact name: Administrator or Reviewer. The console sends it for every role.

200.description: Returns an object with item1, the number of roles added, and item2, the number that failed.

400.description: The roles could not be added.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only administrator access.

404.description: The user does not exist.

post.description:
Gives a group one or more roles in a single call. It handles the built-in Administrator and Reviewer roles and custom roles together. Members of the group receive the roles through the group, and custom roles the group already holds are skipped and not counted. The Administrator role can be given only to a group that is backed by a directory group; otherwise that item counts as failed.

Permission required: Administrator role.

Caution: Adding the Administrator role gives the user or group full administrative access to the console.

parameters.name: managedAccountGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the group (managed account group) on the Users & Groups page.

requestBody.description:
A JSON array of the roles to add. Send each role with its id and name.

- `id` (string (GUID)): The ID of the role. Required for a custom role, which is matched by ID. Not used for the built-in Administrator and Reviewer roles.
- `name` (string): The name of the role. Required for the built-in roles, which are matched by this exact name: Administrator or Reviewer. The console sends it for every role.

200.description: Returns an object with item1, the number of roles added, and item2, the number that failed.

400.description: The roles could not be added.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only administrator access.

404.description: The group does not exist.

get.summary: List the names and IDs of all roles
get.description:
Returns the name and ID of every role, sorted by name, including the built-in Auditors role. Use it to fill a role picker or to look up a role ID. Deleted roles are not included, and the Administrator and Reviewer roles are not listed.

Permission required: Administrator role.

200.description: Returns an array of objects with an id and a name.

400.description: The roles could not be retrieved.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role.

delete.description:
Removes one or more roles from a user in a single call. A signed-in administrator cannot remove their own account from the Administrator role; that item counts as failed. The server reads the list from the request body of this DELETE request, so the body is required. Some HTTP clients and API tools drop the body of a DELETE request; check that yours sends it.

Permission required: Administrator role.

parameters.name: managedAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the user (managed account) on the Users & Groups page.

requestBody.description:
A JSON array of the roles to remove. Send each role with its id and name.

- `id` (string (GUID)): The ID of the role. Required for a custom role, which is matched by ID. Not used for the built-in Administrator and Reviewer roles.
- `name` (string): The name of the role. Required for the built-in roles, which are matched by this exact name: Administrator or Reviewer. The console sends it for every role.

200.description: Returns the number of roles removed (passed), the number that failed, and a message for each item.

400.description: The roles could not be removed.

403.description: The signed-in user does not have the required role, or the account has read-only administrator access.
